versions.changelog: Add --library {zinc,molport} built-in commercial-library switch to plan/score; require synomega>=0.9.4 (RunReactants ring-fix + composable stock).
plan/score: add --forward-consistency (round-trip forward filter). Full feature set: single-step/forward/plan/score/evolve.
plan/score: add --forward-consistency (round-trip forward filter, prunes single-step branching)
Broaden description for discovery; add tags and topics
Overhaul: cover all six capabilities (single-step, forward, plan, score, plausibility, evolve); score defaults to the recommended simplify model
Add forward prediction and multi-component evolution (synomega 0.8.0)

- The synthesizability score in the Python API and output is now named SynScore (`score`) with a new formula; requires synomega >= 0.6.0.
- The previous `bb_coverage` field is still available but is no longer the main synthesizability metric.
- Documentation and examples updated to reflect the change from `bb_coverage` to the new `score`.
- Removed the `skill-card.md` file.

- Added documentation for the new simplification-constrained single-step model (`simplify=True`), which enables faster planning by restricting predictions to fragmentation disconnections.
- Noted the additional model download for the simplification-constrained option.
- Removed the skill-card.md file, streamlining documentation.
- SKILL.md updated to include usage instructions for the new model and clarifies its requirements.
SQP-1: add dual-use/safety-boundary section and narrow activation scope; SQP-2: prominent first-run network+download warning
Plausibility screening now OFF by default (benchmarks: no top-k gain, adds latency); set SYNOMEGA_PLAUSIBILITY=1 to enable.

Screen single-step predictions with the dual-tower reaction-plausibility filter (default on, threshold 0.4); single-step/plan/score drop implausible disconnections; single-step output gains a plausibility field.
Display brand as SynOmega in docs.
Zero-config: the default model + stock now auto-download on first use (synomega 0.3.0). No SYNOMEGA_MODEL/STOCK setup required.
Add --exclude-target (synomega 0.2.0): treat the target as not purchasable even if it is a catalogue molecule.
Package-based: uses the synomega PyPI package locally (Python API + CLI + a helper loading a local model/stock) instead of a hosted API.
Initial release: single-step prediction, multi-step planning, synthesizability scoring over the synomega HTTP API + local package.
